description: White-spotted puffer ​ ( Arothron hispidus ), Anilao, Philippines. The white-spotted puffer fish can reach 50 centimetres (20 in) length. Its distribution extends through the Indo-Pacific area, Red Sea included, to the eastern Pacific Ocean at depths of 3–35 metres (9.8–114.8 ft). Its habitat types include reefs, lagoons, estuaries, and tidepools.
